source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.

1-1.hoa: Both take the initiative and like to get things done; easy to fall into step when the goal is shared.
1-1.va: Both want to hold the wheel — it is easy to fight over who has the final say.
1-1.cung_lam: Agree clearly on which areas each of you gets the last word on.

1-2.hoa: One opens the way, the other keeps the peace — you complement each other easily.
1-2.va: The 1 tends to decide for both; the 2 tends to give in and then feel hurt.
1-2.cung_lam: The 1 asks first; the 2 says what they want instead of waiting to be guessed.

1-3.hoa: High energy and plenty of ideas; you enjoy starting new things together.
1-3.va: The 1 wants to move fast in one direction; the 3 tends to branch off.
1-3.cung_lam: Settle on one shared goal each quarter and both stick to it.

1-4.hoa: One starts things, the other builds the foundation — a pair that gets things done.
1-4.va: The 1 finds the 4 slow; the 4 finds the 1 reckless.
1-4.cung_lam: Agree on 'try small first, go big later' for every new plan.

1-5.hoa: Both love freedom and trying things out, and neither ties the other down much.
1-5.va: Both find long-term commitment hard, and you can drift in different directions.
1-5.cung_lam: Keep a few fixed shared rituals between two free-moving lives.

1-6.hoa: The 1 brings direction, the 6 brings care — one looks after where you are going, the other after the people.
1-6.va: The 1 feels managed; the 6 feels unappreciated.
1-6.cung_lam: The 1 says specific thank-yous; the 6 lets the 1 decide their own share.

1-7.hoa: Both are independent and respect each other's space.
1-7.va: You share few feelings; it is easy to live side by side rather than together.
1-7.cung_lam: Once a week, tell each other what you are really thinking.

1-8.hoa: Both ambitious and results-driven — strong when you share a goal.
1-8.va: Two big egos, power struggles, quiet competition.
1-8.cung_lam: Pick a shared 'opponent' outside instead of fighting each other; split roles clearly.

1-9.hoa: The 1 acts, the 9 inspires — you can easily do meaningful work together.
1-9.va: The 1 finds the 9 vague; the 9 finds the 1 selfish.
1-9.cung_lam: Work together on a project that has both measurable results and a meaning.

2-2.hoa: You understand each other well; gentle, with few big clashes.
2-2.va: Both avoid conflict, so small things pile up into distance.
2-2.cung_lam: Set a regular time to say plainly one thing you are not happy with.

2-3.hoa: The 2 listens, the 3 tells the stories — a warm, cheerful mood.
2-3.va: The 3 is carefree; the 2 is easily hurt by a joke.
2-3.cung_lam: The 3 asks 'did that upset you?'; the 2 says so straight away.

2-4.hoa: Stable, loyal, steady — well suited to building something lasting together.
2-4.va: It can get dull, with few surprises; the 4 can be dry about the 2's need for attention.

2-5.hoa: The 5 brings fresh air, the 2 brings warmth.
2-5.va: The 2 needs closeness, the 5 needs freedom — easily mistaken for love fading.
2-5.cung_lam: Put numbers on your need for space and your need for connection (how many evenings a week).

2-6.hoa: Both are thoughtful and look after each other — very warm.
2-6.va: Both give a lot and ask for little, then resent it quietly when it is not returned.
2-6.cung_lam: Each of you names one of your own needs every week.

2-7.hoa: Quiet, deep, respectful of each other.
2-7.va: The 2 needs closeness, the 7 needs distance — the 2 can easily feel left out.
2-7.cung_lam: The 7 says in advance when they need time alone; the 2 plans something of their own then.

2-8.hoa: The 8 looks after the big picture, the 2 looks after the bond — a good complement.
2-8.va: The 8 tends to dominate; the 2 tends to go quiet.
2-8.cung_lam: Big decisions always need both of you to agree.

2-9.hoa: Both full of compassion and quick to empathise.
2-9.va: Both tend to sacrifice themselves and stay vague about money and responsibilities.
2-9.cung_lam: Make a clear shared financial plan.

3-3.hoa: Fun, creative, plenty to talk about.
3-3.va: Both scatter easily, and nobody minds the practical side.
3-3.cung_lam: Split practical tasks on a schedule, with a shared list.

3-4.hoa: The 3 brings joy, the 4 brings reliability.
3-4.va: The 4 finds the 3 irresponsible; the 3 finds the 4 rigid.
3-4.cung_lam: The 3 keeps small promises; the 4 leaves room for spontaneity.

3-5.hoa: Lively, fun, fond of new experiences — rarely bored.
3-5.va: Not much stability; together you can overspend and leave things unfinished.
3-5.cung_lam: Set a long-term shared goal and let one person keep the budget.

3-6.hoa: The 3 makes things fun, the 6 makes them warm.
3-6.va: The 6 can fuss and remind too much; the 3 feels hemmed in.
3-6.cung_lam: The 6 reminds less; the 3 takes on a share of the joint chores without being asked.

3-7.hoa: The 3 draws the 7 out; the 7 helps the 3 go deeper.
3-7.va: The 3 finds the 7 cold; the 7 finds the 3 shallow.
3-7.cung_lam: Alternate lively, social activities with quiet ones.

3-8.hoa: The 3 is good at communicating, the 8 at organising — a good business pair.
3-8.va: The 8 finds the 3 not serious enough; the 3 finds the 8 too calculating.
3-8.cung_lam: Split roles: the 3 handles the outside world, the 8 runs operations.

3-9.hoa: Emotionally rich; both love beauty and things that mean something.
3-9.va: Neither is very practical, so necessary tasks get skipped.
3-9.cung_lam: Once a month, go over the practical side (money, paperwork) together.

4-4.hoa: Very stable, well planned, trustworthy with each other.
4-4.va: Rigid, slow to change, easily bored.
4-4.cung_lam: Try one new thing together every year.

4-5.hoa: The 4 gives roots, the 5 gives wind — you can learn a lot from each other.
4-5.va: The 4 finds the 5 unsettled; the 5 finds the 4 restrictive.
4-5.cung_lam: Agree on what is 'fixed' and what is 'flexible' in your life together.

4-6.hoa: Both responsible and caring towards the people around you; you build a solid base.
4-6.cung_lam: Keep some time purely for fun, with no talk of what needs doing.

4-7.hoa: Both serious, careful and respectful of reason.
4-7.cung_lam: Practise putting feelings into words, not only into actions.

4-8.hoa: A practical pair, good at building assets and careers.
4-8.va: Swept up in work, you forget the relationship.
4-8.cung_lam: Keep private time separate from time spent talking about money.

4-9.hoa: The 4 turns the 9's ideals into reality.
4-9.va: The 9 finds the 4 short-sighted; the 4 finds the 9 unrealistic.
4-9.cung_lam: The 9 states the purpose, the 4 makes the plan — and both sign off on it.

5-5.hoa: Free, lively, full of shared experiences.
5-5.va: Not much stability; commitment and routine are hard.
5-5.cung_lam: Keep a few fixed commitments even while living flexibly.

5-6.hoa: The 5 brings something new, the 6 brings a home.
5-6.va: The 6 wants to hold on, the 5 wants to go.
5-6.cung_lam: The 5 shares plans in advance; the 6 respects the freedom you have agreed on.

5-7.hoa: Both curious and fond of exploring (the 5 outwards, the 7 inwards).
5-7.va: Different rhythms of life make it hard to spend time together.
5-7.cung_lam: Choose experiences that are both adventurous and deep (cultural travel, learning something together).

5-8.hoa: Energetic and bold — a good business pair.
5-8.va: Both take risks and can make big mistakes by deciding fast.
5-8.cung_lam: Every big money decision waits one day and gets input from a third person.

5-9.hoa: Both expansive, fond of travel, generous.
5-9.cung_lam: Have a shared savings goal and one fixed place to come home to.

6-6.va: Both want to do the caring, so you can end up controlling each other and worn out by duty.
6-6.cung_lam: Take turns being the one who is cared for and the one who does the caring.

6-7.hoa: The 6 brings warmth, the 7 brings depth.
6-7.va: The 6 feels pushed away; the 7 feels intruded upon.
6-7.cung_lam: Agree on personal space and on how to check in with each other.

6-8.hoa: The 8 takes care of material things, the 6 of emotional ones — a solid family.
6-8.va: The 8 is often absent; the 6 feels alone with the responsibilities.
6-8.cung_lam: The 8 treats being there for important occasions like a work commitment.

6-9.hoa: Both full of compassion and fond of helping others.
6-9.va: You look after outsiders so much that you forget each other.
6-9.cung_lam: Make time for just the two of you before shared obligations.

7-7.hoa: You understand each other without many words and respect each other's space.
7-7.va: Too closed off; you can slowly drift apart.
7-7.cung_lam: Share an intellectual interest so you always have something in common.

7-8.hoa: The 7 analyses, the 8 decides — good for big undertakings.
7-8.va: The 8 finds the 7 slow; the 7 finds the 8 hasty.
7-8.cung_lam: The 7 delivers analysis by a deadline; the 8 waits until that deadline.

7-9.hoa: Both drawn to meaning, the inner life and knowledge.
7-9.va: Both drift away from practical matters.
7-9.cung_lam: Make practical plans together for the things you both believe in.

8-8.hoa: Both ambitious; you can build a lot.
8-8.va: Power struggles, competition, getting swept up in money.
8-8.cung_lam: Split roles clearly; set a shared goal that has nothing to do with money.

8-9.hoa: The 8 has the resources, the 9 has the ideals — together you can do big, useful things.
8-9.va: The 9 finds the 8 calculating; the 8 finds the 9 wasteful.
8-9.cung_lam: Decide together on a share of income for something meaningful, and save the rest.

9-9.hoa: Generous, idealistic, aligned on what matters in life.
9-9.va: Both tend to neglect practical matters and themselves.
9-9.cung_lam: Have one person take charge of the practical side each month.
